$comment: Trust root for upstream release manifests. A sidecar pin (sidecars.lock.json, scripts/fetch-waved.mjs) may only hold hashes from a manifest that at least `minSignatures` of these keys signed (detached manifest-<signer>-<tag>.sig). Fingerprints are the primary-key fingerprints Lightning Labs publishes in lightningnetwork/lnd scripts/verify-install.sh (KEYS list); each .asc beside this file is that repo's scripts/keys/<signer>.asc, copied 2026-11-16. scripts/verify-release.mjs imports each key into its own keyring and accepts a signature only when gpg reports VALIDSIG for exactly the pinned fingerprint. Changing this file changes who we trust: review fingerprints against lnd's verify-install.sh before merging.

litd.$comment: lightning-terminal releases carry one release-manager signature (its release workflow: manifest-<signer>-<tag>.sig). v0.17.8 is signed by roasbeef, v0.17.10 and v0.17.11 by ViktorT-11.

waved.$comment: Wavelength v0.2.0 and v0.2.1 are each signed by both bhandras and sputn1ck; require both.
